definition: The group of words for how badly a named error reads to someone fluent: fatal, serious or minor.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`severity` holds how badly a named error reads to someone fluent", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
